reason: A named lab and a report for my exact batch is the first time one of these has answered my 'is it tested or just marketing' question. At $24.99 for a first box with my money back if I finish it, I'll risk one box.
objection: I have a drawer of half-used bottles already. I don't know if I'll actually take it every night, and the guarantee only works if I finish all 30 sachets.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code report turned out to be missing or not matching the batch number on the box, I'd walk away.
